consent_note: Role-played transcript for local development. No real clients. No real meeting took place and no real people are quoted.
title: Lakeside Makers Guild — follow-up to the search meeting

turns.text: This follow-up is the same Lakeside directory project as the search and mobile meeting. What changed?
Add one requirement. A visitor should be able to save a shortlist of member profiles and see that shortlist again on the same phone.
A saved shortlist of member profiles. Does it have to work for guests who are not logged in?
Yes, a visitor who is not a member. If that needs an account, stop and ask me first. I am not asking for a new social network.
Remove one feature. Drop the years-in-business filter. We are not doing that. Take it out of the scope completely.
Years in business is removed. I will not estimate it and I will not leave it as an open maybe.
The member showcase moved from April 18 to June 6. That is the date people are holding in their heads. I am not asking you to promise June 6.
I will record the change from April 18 to June 6 as your expectation, not as our delivery commitment. The proposal still will not name a delivery date.
City, category, and the mobile behavior from last time still stand. The map is still not agreed. Do not resolve the map in this meeting.
Confirmed. The shortlist is added, years in business is removed, the showcase expectation changed, and the map stays an open disagreement.
